purpose: Test whether the already-built full repaired train-output vocabulary recovers sealed-parent throughput by shortening generated trajectories after removal of the per-step token-map reconstruction defect.

measured_rationale.finding: The full repaired vocabulary already demonstrated a 7.6 percent sequence-length advantage over v31. Its earlier timing included a larger avoidable map-rebuild penalty than v31, so corrected execution can reverse the old throughput ordering without any artifact change.

single_screen: Run the unchanged 40-observation, 20-distinct-prompt, 1,024-byte sustained benchmark with 16 threads.
pass_rule: All unchanged sustained gates must pass, including at least 95 percent sealed-parent throughput, at least 2x Qwen median, and paired bootstrap lower bound at least 2x.
stop_rule: Do not create a neighboring vocabulary if this exact existing artifact fails. Profile the remaining measured runtime or sequence bottleneck.
